newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Denmark to call for EU support against China.
newsitem.headline: Denmark to call for EU support against China.

text.p: Denmark will appeal next week to fellow European Union members for support against retaliation from Beijing for Copenhagen's sponsorship of a U.N. resolution critical of China's human rights record.

EU diplomatic sources said Danish Foreign Minister Niels Helveg Petersen would call at a General Affairs Council in Luxembourg on Tuesday for solidarity against what he believes are threats against his country.
"The Chinese are now putting pressure on Denmark in the commercial field," one diplomat said, adding the the Dutch and others were also likely to join in the appeal.
China has reacted furiously to Denmark's sponsorship of an annual resolution at the the U.N. Human Rights Commission criticising Beijing for its lack of respect for rights.
The resolution, which had U.S. support, was blocked by China on April 15.
Denmark decided to sponsor the resolution after France blocked agreement for the EU to support the resolution as a bloc. Germany, Spain and Italy later supported France.
Beijing responded intitially bu cancelling visits by Danish officials, but diplomats said other pressure is now being applied.
